facts.fact: 作者说明原型：16 世纪阿伯丁郡的 Alexander Skene，Skene 庄园的领主，民间称「Skene 的巫师领主」。
facts.anchor: In sixteenth-century Aberdeenshire there lived a man called Alexander Skene

facts.fact: 传说他上魔鬼的黑魔法学校、割影逃脱；临终又说服魔鬼让各自使魔决斗，他的喜鹊撕碎魔鬼的渡鸦，赢回灵魂。
facts.anchor: alleged that the first incident came when Alexander attended

facts.fact: 作者说这两个故事让她着迷，觉得没人好好重述过，于是想写这对「恶魔搭档」的浪漫故事。
facts.anchor: both stories really captured my imagination

facts.fact: 她在《Aberdeenshire Folk Tales》里读到 Alexander 的故事，包括与魔鬼同车坠湖、冰上留下车辙的传说。
facts.anchor: When I first came across Alexander

facts.fact: 传说他诅咒 ceilidh 的舞者乐手跳到手脚流血；还有坟墓被铁链锁住、绕坟百圈复活的传说。
facts.anchor: Alexander is also said to have put a curse on the dancers and musicians at a ceilidh

facts.fact: 她亲访 Skene House，感到「有什么邪恶发生过」，庄园成了小说的场景。
facts.anchor: Skene House is the setting that brought In Your Heart a Devil to life for me

facts.fact: 历史上 Alexander 有妻有子，妻子名叫 Giles Ædie，但记载极少；作者想写「男人背后的女人」。
facts.anchor: we know next to nothing about

facts.fact: 作者说 Isabel 的渴望与内心空洞才是故事中心，Alexander 只是「也在那儿」；她希望 Isabel 替被历史遗忘的女性发声。
facts.anchor: her yearnings, the gaps inside her
